argv:
import hashlib, json
from pathlib import Path
root = Path.cwd()
folder = Path("../checks/tool-proposal/canonical_labels")
digest = lambda path: hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
records = {name: json.loads((folder / name).read_text()) for name in ("outline.report.json", "counting.report.json", "intentional-negative.report.json")}
checks = {}
for name in ("outline.report.json", "counting.report.json"):
    report = records[name]
    checks[name + ":tool_hash"] = digest(folder / "canonical_labels.py") == report["tool_source"]["sha256"]
    checks[name + ":ledger_hash"] = digest(root / report["canonical_file"]["path"]) == report["canonical_file"]["sha256"]
    checks[name + ":program_hash"] = hashlib.sha256(report["program"].encode()).hexdigest() == report["program_sha256"]
    checks[name + ":runtime_sources"] = all(digest(root / path) == sha for path, sha in report["execution"]["runtime_source_sha256"].items())
    generator = report["selected_generator"]
    checks[name + ":generator_hash"] = not generator["present"] or digest(root / generator["path"]) == generator["sha256"]
    checks[name + ":all_pairs_match"] = report["exit_code"] == 0 and all(pair["status"] == "match" and pair["expected"] == pair["actual"] for pair in report["pairs"])
negative = records["intentional-negative.report.json"]
checks["negative:source_receipt_hash"] = digest(folder / "counting.report.json") == negative["source_report_sha256"]
checks["negative:explicit_intent"] = negative["natural_source_defect"] is False and negative["fresh_racket_execution"] is False
checks["negative:exit_and_counts"] = negative["exit_code"] == 1 and negative["counts"] == {"labeled_pairs": 5, "match": 4, "mismatch": 1, "error": 0}
checks["negative:script_hash"] = digest(folder / "demonstrate_corruption.py") == negative["script_sha256"]
sources = {name: digest(folder / name) for name in ("canonical_labels.py", "test_canonical_labels.py", "README.md", "demonstrate_corruption.py")}
result = {"passed": all(checks.values()), "checks": checks, "source_sha256": sources}
with (folder / "artifact-inspection.json").open("x") as stream:
    json.dump(result, stream, indent=2)
    stream.write("\n")
cache = folder / "__pycache__"
if cache.is_dir():
    for generated in cache.glob("*.pyc"):
        generated.unlink()
    if not any(cache.iterdir()):
        cache.rmdir()
print(json.dumps(result, sort_keys=True))
assert result["passed"]
